_comment: Autobattle recipes earned by playing manually (struktured 2026-11-23). UNWIRED until the autobattle spec is approved: nothing calls RecipeLedger yet. ids follow battle's 26887 starter catalog; name/line/flavour are cowir-story's 26928 draft and are theirs to edit. threshold is per recipe so his 'maybe 10' is a data edit. rule is one rule in the autobattle_rule_templates.json shape, validated by AutobattleSystem.validate_rule. Which choices COUNT toward a recipe is RecipeMatcher's job (battle lane), not this file's.
